gallery.title: File:Rich Mountain Battlefield West Virginia.jpg
gallery.description:
Map of battlefield core and study areas.
The Study Area and Core Area were expanded to take in the area of Federal flank attack.

The revised Study Area also includes the Confederate withdrawal route.
